Senate File 2480, a bill for an act relating to the taxation and regulation of alternative
nicotine products and vapor products, making appropriations, and including effective
date provisions.
Fiscal Note: No
Recommendation: Do Pass May 2, 2026.
Final Vote: Yeas, 20: Representatives Mohr-CH, Weldon-VC, Srinivas-RM, Bergan,
Bossman, Bradley, Collins, Cooling, Gehlbach, R. Johnson, Konfrst, Lawler, Lohse,
Matson, A. Meyer, Mommsen, Nielsen, Sorensen, Wilburn, Wood. Nays, 1: Stone.
Excused, 4: Blom, Latham, Wilz, Zabner.
Placed on the Appropriations Calendar, May 2, 2026.
                                                              MEGHAN NELSON
                                                          Chief Clerk of the House

  Kaufmann of Cedar asked and received unanimous consent to
immediately consider Senate File 2480.

                         CONSIDERATION OF BILLS
                           Appropriations Calendar

   Senate File 2480, a bill for an act relating to the taxation and
regulation of alternative nicotine products and vapor products, making
appropriations, and including effective date provisions, with report of
committee recommending passage, was taken up for consideration.
